summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of ALFATWIN admin Reports page after overnight-shift bug fix. Verified: (1) admin login with richy@gmail.com/alfa123 loads Panel; (2) Reports 'Este Mes' filter renders new columns 'Entrada · fecha y hora' and 'Salida · fecha y hora'; (3) overnight shift pairing across midnight for Gabriel Ferreira works — one row shows entrada 'lun, 29 jun 21:30' → salida 'mar, 30 jun 05:00' (7h 30m) and a separate open shift row 'mar, 30 jun 21:30' → '—'; (4) Excel button downloads .xls; (5) PDF button downloads .pdf and confirm dialog to delete photos was auto-dismissed (photos preserved). Zero JS console errors during the whole flow.
action_items: MINOR: /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists admin password as 'richy123' but the real working password (per task and Supabase Auth) is 'alfa123'. Update the credentials file to reflect 'alfa123' to avoid future testing confusion.

MINOR (code review): The 'confirm' dialog to delete server photos fires right after every PDF download (single-emp mode too), even when the user only wanted a plain PDF. Consider prompting only in 'share' mode, or moving photo cleanup to a separate explicit button, so accidental clicks on 'PDF' cannot cause data loss for the admin.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx (~L170-L219): generateAndShare() ALWAYS asks the destructive window.confirm to delete server photos, regardless of mode ('download' vs 'share'). This is a UX/risk concern — a user pressing 'PDF' might accept the confirm and permanently delete storage-hosted photos. Recommend gating photo-cleanup behind an explicit 'Purgar fotos' button, or at minimum, only prompting after 'share'.

Reports.jsx line 177: dateLabel hardcodes rangeToISO() as todayISO() (`(${rangeFromISO()} → ${todayISO()})`) even for 'custom' range → PDF header will show today's date instead of the chosen 'Hasta'. Bug in PDF header when using custom range.

Reports.jsx line 32-42: For range='mes' the code uses `t.getDate() - 30` on a JS Date, which is a rolling 30-day window, not the calendar month. The button label says 'Este mes' — semantics mismatch (task note also confirms this). If a strict 'calendar month' is desired, use start-of-month. Currently OK because seeded data (29-30 jun) falls inside the last 30 days on 2026-07-06.
format.js buildShifts (L131): correctly walks marks and pairs entrada→next salida across days. Verified in UI. Good.
test_credentials: admin: richy@gmail.com / alfa123 (WORKS). richy123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) returned 400 Unauthorized.
seed_data_creation: None — used seed data prepared by main agent (Gabriel Ferreira overnight shift 29-30 jun 2026).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Overnight shift bug is FIXED and verified in UI. Table headers on /admin/reportes are 'Entrada · fecha y hora' and 'Salida · fecha y hora'. Gabriel's overnight shift renders correctly (lun 29 jun 21:30 → mar 30 jun 05:00 = 7h 30m; and open shift mar 30 jun 21:30 → —). Excel + PDF downloads work with zero JS errors. The confirm('Eliminar las fotos respaldadas...') dialog always fires after PDF — dismiss it in tests. Note: admin password is 'alfa123' (test_credentials.md is stale with 'richy123').
rca_of_the_issue: The reported bug (turno nocturno lost after midnight) was caused by pairing marks only within the same calendar date. Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/format.js buildShifts() now walks marks ordered ASC by created_at and pairs each 'entrada' with the next 'salida' regardless of date, correctly emitting one shift row that spans two ISO dates. Reports.jsx also loads marks from `fromISO - 1 day` (addDaysISO(-1)) so shifts on the boundary aren't cut. UI now renders two date columns (entrada.fecha, salida.fecha) each with its own formatDateEs label. Verified with real Supabase data.
